title: NVIDIA Illumina Acquisition | The fusion of AI and human DNA?

comments.author: @kingothesea1
comments.text: I am extremely pro Illumina acquisition.    It's fairly clear in the modern day that advancing AI will require magnitudes more data then what most folks realize.   This marriage between these two companies would set the brick on the pedal in terms of DNA analysis and beginning to actually make solid sense of our genetics.    You mentioned negligible senescence I've always felt as if it's possible in the animal/plant kingdom its possible for us.    I've always wanted to be able to sense infrared or sense magnetic poles.    Simply a matter of time when you factor in technological advancements such as this.     An exabyte is really a quite monstrous amount of data.
